name: Main Auditorium
description: Bennett University's primary large-scale event venue. Equipped with a professional stage, audio-visual system, LED display screens, and fixed seating. Used for convocations, major cultural events, annual fests, and large technical seminars.

name: Seminar Hall 1
description: A well-equipped seminar hall with tiered seating, a projector, and videoconferencing facilities. Commonly used for departmental seminars, workshops, guest lectures, and committee meetings.

name: Seminar Hall 2
description: Mid-sized seminar hall with flat-floor layout, movable seating, and presentation facilities. Popular for club events, panel discussions, and interactive workshops.

name: Seminar Hall 3
description: A smaller seminar room ideal for focused workshops, MUN committee sessions, and departmental events. Has a whiteboard, projector, and breakout spaces nearby.

name: Innovation Lab
description: Bennett University's flagship maker space and innovation hub. Equipped with 3D printers, soldering stations, IoT kits, prototyping tools, and high-performance workstations. The go-to venue for hackathons, robotics sessions, and project build days.

name: Computer Science Lab 1
description: Primary computing lab with individual workstations running Windows and Linux dual-boot. Used for coding workshops, hackathon warm-ups, and programming bootcamps.

name: Computer Science Lab 2
description: Secondary computing lab configured for cloud computing, networking, and DevOps labs. Features enterprise networking equipment and cloud lab workstations.

name: Campus Amphitheatre
description: An open-air amphitheatre at the heart of the Bennett University campus. A popular venue for cultural performances, open-mic nights, informal gatherings, and outdoor events.

name: Cricket Ground
description: A well-maintained cricket ground with a turf pitch and spectator seating. Used for inter-department cricket leagues, Sports Day events, and informal cricket matches.

name: Electronics & Robotics Lab
description: Specialised lab equipped with oscilloscopes, signal generators, microcontroller kits (Arduino, Raspberry Pi), and robotics components. Used by the Robotics Club and for embedded systems workshops.
